Address.sdk_representation: Encode a Stellar account or contract address as a Soroban Address ScVal.

i128.sdk_representation: Use bigint or a base-10 integer string and encode it as a Soroban i128 ScVal; never use a floating-point value.

VaultError.sdk_representation: Decode the contract error discriminant using the errors table.

errors.name: AlreadyInitialized
errors.description: The vault has already been initialized.

errors.name: NotInitialized
errors.description: A method that requires initialized state was called before initialize succeeded.

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.description: The amount is not positive or checked accounting arithmetic failed.

errors.name: InsufficientBalance
errors.description: The requested withdrawal exceeds the user's stored deposit balance.

errors.name: InvalidRewardState
errors.description: This error is defined by the current contract but is not returned by any current public method.

methods.name: initialize

arguments.name: admin
arguments.description: Address assigned as vault admin and required to authorize this invocation.

arguments.name: deposit_token
arguments.description: Address recorded as the accepted deposit token.

arguments.name: reward_token
arguments.description: Address recorded as the reward token.

returns.description: Returns success with no value, or AlreadyInitialized when state already exists.

authorization.description: The admin argument must authorize the invocation.

notes: May succeed only once.
Stores the admin and token addresses and initializes total deposits and reward balance to zero.

methods.name: deposit

arguments.name: from
arguments.description: Address whose stored deposit balance is credited and that must authorize the invocation.

arguments.name: amount
arguments.description: Positive number of smallest token units to add to accounting.

returns.description: Returns the user's new stored deposit balance.

authorization.description: The from argument must authorize the invocation.

notes: Rejects amounts less than or equal to zero.
Updates vault accounting only; no deposit-token transfer is implemented.

methods.name: withdraw

arguments.name: to
arguments.description: Address whose stored deposit balance is debited and that must authorize the invocation.

arguments.name: amount
arguments.description: Positive number of smallest token units to subtract from accounting.

returns.description: Returns the user's new stored deposit balance.

authorization.description: The to argument must authorize the invocation.

notes: Rejects non-positive amounts and amounts greater than the user's stored balance.
Updates vault accounting only; no deposit-token transfer is implemented.

methods.name: claim_rewards

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: Address whose stored claimable reward is cleared and that must authorize the invocation.

returns.description: Returns the stored amount claimed, or zero when no amount is claimable.

authorization.description: The user argument must authorize the invocation.

notes: The claim event is emitted whenever the stored claimable amount is nonzero.
Clears per-user claimable accounting only; no reward-token transfer is implemented.
The amount paid by this method is distinct from the pending_rewards proportional view.

methods.name: set_claimable_reward

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: Address whose claimable reward entry is replaced.

arguments.name: amount
arguments.description: Value written to claimable reward storage without amount validation.

returns.description: Returns success with no value or NotInitialized.

authorization.description: The current implementation performs no authorization check.

notes: This callable contract method is not intended as a wallet-facing SDK operation.
No require_auth call or amount validation is implemented.

methods.name: set_reward_balance

arguments.name: amount
arguments.description: Value written to the vault-wide reward balance without amount validation.

returns.description: Returns success with no value or NotInitialized.

authorization.description: The current implementation performs no authorization check.

notes: This callable contract method is not intended as a wallet-facing SDK operation.
No require_auth call or amount validation is implemented.

methods.name: is_initialized

returns.description: Returns true when initialized state exists and false otherwise.

notes: This is the only public method that can be queried before initialization without returning NotInitialized.

methods.name: admin
notes: Returns NotInitialized before initialization.

methods.name: owner

returns.description: Returns the same stored address as admin.

notes: This method is currently an alias for admin.

methods.name: deposit_token

returns.description: Returns the deposit-token address recorded at initialization.

notes: The token address is configuration only; current deposit and withdrawal methods do not invoke it.

methods.name: reward_token

returns.description: Returns the reward-token address recorded at initialization.

notes: The token address is configuration only; current claim_rewards does not invoke it.

methods.name: total_deposits

returns.description: Returns the vault-wide stored deposit total.

notes: The value is accounting state and does not query the configured token contract.

methods.name: user_balance

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: Address whose stored deposit balance is requested.

returns.description: Returns the user's stored deposit balance, defaulting to zero when no balance entry exists.

notes: Invoke the exact contract symbol user_balance; get_balance is not implemented.

methods.name: pending_rewards

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: Address whose proportional pending reward view is requested.

returns.description: Returns the calculated proportional share of the vault-wide reward balance.

notes: Calculates user_balance multiplied by reward balance and divided by total deposits using checked arithmetic.
Returns zero for non-positive inputs or multiplication overflow.
This is not the per-user amount consumed by claim_rewards.

events.name: init

fields.name: admin
fields.description: The initialized admin address is the complete event data value.

events.description: Emitted after a successful initialization has written vault state.

events.name: deposit

fields.name: from
fields.description: The address credited by the deposit.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: The deposited amount, not the resulting balance.

events.description: Emitted after deposit accounting is updated successfully.

events.name: withdraw

fields.name: to
fields.description: The address debited by the withdrawal.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: The withdrawn amount, not the resulting balance.

events.description: Emitted after withdrawal accounting is updated successfully.

events.name: claim

fields.name: user
fields.description: The address whose claimable accounting was cleared.

fields.name: claimable
fields.description: The nonzero amount returned by claim_rewards.

events.description: Emitted when claim_rewards succeeds with a nonzero stored claimable amount.

limitations: Deposit and withdrawal change internal accounting but do not transfer deposit tokens.
Claiming changes internal accounting but does not transfer reward tokens.
No share token, exchange rate, lock period, get_info, get_balance, or get_pending_rewards method is implemented.
set_claimable_reward and set_reward_balance are publicly invocable in the current contract and currently have no authorization check.
pending_rewards is a proportional view and is not the claimable amount consumed by claim_rewards.
